verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke documents a dedicated EC/VC practice that advises on fundraising 'from seed and Series A' and on term sheets and investment structures. It also publishes early-stage resources: an investor-readiness tool and free UK/DE cap table templates. That satisfies the 'stated early-stage financing practice' prong, but nothing in the evidence mentions SAFEs, convertible notes/ASAs, or pre-seed specifically. Missing for 10: explicit SAFE/convertible instrument experience, published convertible explainers or forms, pre-seed-specific coverage, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm documents deep experience with SAFEs and convertible instruments for pre-seed and seed rounds — published explainers, forms, or a stated early-stage financing practice

citations.quote: Our core focus is on investor fundraising and related strategic transactions, from seed and Series A through to larger institutional and growth rounds. We advise on term sheets, valuation mechanics, investment structures, investor rights and governance
Osborne Clarke's emerging companies and venture capital (EC/VC) team is our dedicated multi-disciplinary team for high-growth companies and venture capital and growth equity investors.
Our quick online tool will help you check, giving you a personalised report, investor-ready score and a rundown of where any gaps might be
